description:
Type de projet: Site Web
Client: Pavage Diamand, nettoyage à pression et scellant d'asphalte.

But: Présenter les services de l'entreprise.
Public cible: Particuliers.

Fonctionnalités clés:
- Galerie de photos
- Tarifs et forfaits
- Coordonnées de contact
- Présentation de l'équipe et de la méthode de travail

designManifest.iconDirection: Flat geometric diamond/lozenge mark evoking a freshly striped asphalt surface — anthracite field with a single diagonal indigo stripe cutting through and a crisp white edge highlight, emblem style.
designManifest.signatureMove: Numbered job-spec sections with repeating indigo stripe bands as dividers, plus an omnipresent fixed bottom call-bar (click-to-call + booking) on mobile so the CTA never leaves the screen.
designManifest.summary: The site is structured like a freshly striped job sheet on new asphalt — anthracite ground, numbered spec sections (01–04), and painted indigo hazard-stripe bands doing the dividing and wayfinding work.
designManifest.typography: Barlow Condensed heavy uppercase display + Barlow body — a trades-grade, signage-like voice

promptHistory.changeNotes:
Built the full Pavage Diamand PWA: bilingual FR/EN site with hero, numbered services/process/team/gallery sections, pricing packages, photo gallery with category filters, booking and contact forms (stored in DB with email notification fallback), an omnipresent click-to-call bar on mobile, and a complete admin backend (dashboard + CRUD modules for bookings, messages, services, packages, gallery, team and posts). Assumed standard business hours and seeded the owner's contact info as editable settings.

Admin enrichment: (1) Rebuilt the admin sidebar with sectioned navigation and inline SVG icons for every module. (2) Upgraded the dashboard with icon-driven stat cards, richer module cards (count + label + 'Gérer →'), panel headers with quick-view links, and a new functional 'Coordonnées & réglages' editor that writes to /api/admin/settings (business name, phone, email, service area, address, hours) with toast feedback. (3) Enhanced the shared admin CRUD shell (admin-shell.ejs): result count pill, polished empty-state with first-item CTA, live image preview on URL input, modal subtitle, Escape-to-close, and success/error toast notifications on create/update/delete. (4) Overhauled admin-styles.css for stronger contrast, rounded cards, visible focus-visible states, hover rows, toast component, and responsive settings grid. (5) Added focus-visible outlines to the public stylesheet for accessibility. Functional admin data (services, pricing packages with prices, gallery, team, posts, bookings, messages) remains fully create/edit/delete-able from each module page. All {{IMG_*}} placeholder tokens preserved byte-for-byte; routes/data flows and bilingual content untouched except passing settings to the dashboard view.
